claim: WisdomTree launched the CBOE S&P 500 PutWrite Strategy Fund (PUTW) on NYSE Arca on 2016-02-24, tracking the Cboe S&P 500 PutWrite Index (PUT) before fees; the fund sells at-the-money, European-style, one-month S&P 500 Index puts against a fully collateralized T-bill account and rebalances (rolls the options) monthly.
quote: today announced the launch of the CBOE S&P 500 PutWrite Strategy Fund (PUTW), on the NYSE Arca
market_and_period: US, WisdomTree CBOE S&P 500 PutWrite Strategy Fund (PUTW), NYSE Arca, launch press release.
applicability: Grounds PUTW_HOLD's proxy inception date (2016-02-24) and the monthly-rebalance mechanism the candidate manifest declares (freq M); used to state honestly that PUTW is a proxy for weekly SPY cash-secured put selling (dir:put_credit_spread_income's original ERN-style claim), not a literal replication -- PUTW writes monthly, at-the-money, index-level (SPX) puts, not weekly ~20-30 delta single-name/SPY puts.
limitations: Marketing press release, not the fund's prospectus or NAV history; performance framing (97% of S&P 500 return, 77% of volatility, 6/30/07-12/31/15) is WisdomTree's own citation of pre-launch backtested PUT index data, not PUTW's own live track record.
independent_replication: Cross-checked against the CBOE PUT index's own official fact sheet (see wisdomtree_putw_launch_2016's companion card cboe_put_index_factsheet_2026), which independently confirms the same at-the-money monthly SPX put-write mechanism and a live index history since 2007.
impact_on_spec: Fixes PUTW_HOLD's universe (PUTW only), freq (M, monthly matching the fund's own roll cadence) and proxy_inception (2016-02-24) in candidate-manifest.json; also grounds the decision to label it an honest proxy rather than a literal replication of dir:put_credit_spread_income's weekly SPY structure.

claim: Cboe's own official strategy-index fact sheet (data as of 2026-08-31) states the Cboe S&P 500 PutWrite Index (PUT) has an index launch date of 2007-06-20 (first value date 2007-01-03) and reports, from 2007-01-03 through the fact-sheet date, an annualized return of 7.1%, annualized volatility 10.7%, maximum drawdown -32.7%, beta 0.6, Sharpe ratio 0.52 and Sortino ratio 0.69 (vs. 11.0%/15.4%/-50.9%/1.0/0.61/0.92 for the S&P 500 Total Return Index over the same window); SPX puts are struck at-the-money and sold monthly, usually on the 3rd Friday.
market_and_period: Cboe S&P 500 PutWrite Index (PUT), 2007-01-03 through 2026-08-31, monthly SPX at-the-money put writing vs. T-bill collateral.
applicability: Independent, official-exchange confirmation of the PUT index mechanism (monthly, at-the-money, 3rd-Friday roll) that PUTW is designed to track; supplies the long-run index-level Sharpe (0.52) used as context for judging whether PUTW_HOLD's proxy is even directionally plausible before running any backtest.
limitations: Index-level statistics (no fund fees/expenses/tracking error); PUTW itself (0.38% net expense ratio) will underperform the index by roughly that amount annually; the fact-sheet's own disclosure states periods before the 2007-06-20 index launch are back-tested, not live.
independent_replication: Matches the WisdomTree launch press release's own citation of the same CBOE-sourced PUT index mechanism (see wisdomtree_putw_launch_2016).
impact_on_spec: Documents the PUT index's official monthly/at-the-money/3rd-Friday roll convention referenced in candidate-manifest.json's PUTW_HOLD entry and its proxy caveat; long-run index Sharpe (0.52) recorded as external context only, not used as a substitute for our own K1/K2 test.
